item.title: The Gym Group: positive trading to be reported early next month, shares are on the growth tack, with an easy 25% uplift in view
item.summary: On Wednesday 9th September, The Gym Group (LON:GYM) will announce its Interim Results – they will be good. The £368m-capitalised group was a pioneer of the low-cost gym model and now operates some 264 high-quality sites across the UK. I am looking forward to the accompanying statement with the figures, which could well be positive enough to put some added spring in the step of the […] The post The Gym Group: positive trading to be reported early next month, shares are on the growth tack, with an easy 25% uplift in view appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
